canonical_project: China Telecom Jiangbei Data Center / Jiangbei Computing Center (Yizheng Park)
notes: Opened in Yizheng in 2021; China Telecom invested project on 306 mu with reported total investment RMB 12bn. Later Jiangsu report says plan is 11 data buildings and 2 integration buildings, 32,000 high-power racks at full build, with 5 buildings completed and about 2,200 racks delivered as of 2024.
